paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Loss comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss comparison of two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The x-axis, labeled "Step", has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 60000 and tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", has a linear scale with a value range of 2 × 10^0 to 1.2 × 10^1 and tick labels at intervals of 2 × 10^0. The plot contains four lines: Ex1 Loss (blue, solid, circle markers), Ex2 Loss (cyan, solid, circle markers), Ex1 Validation Loss (blue, dashed, circle markers), and Ex2 Validation Loss (cyan, dashed, circle markers). The Ex1 Loss line starts at approximately 3 × 10^0 and decreases to around 2 × 10^0. The Ex2 Loss line starts at approximately 4 × 10^0 and decreases to around 3 × 10^0. The Ex1 Validation Loss line starts at approximately 1 × 10^1 and decreases to around 3 × 10^0. The Ex2 Validation Loss line starts at approximately 1.1 × 10^1 and decreases to around 3.5 × 10^0.
